briefdescription.para: A class representing a linear system of equations.

detaileddescription.para: The LinearSystem class provides functionality to store and manipulate a linear system of equations. It supports the storage of the coefficient matrix and the right-hand side vector, as well as the solution vector.

parameterdescription.para: The value type of the system and boundary matrix coefficients.
The value type of the right-hand side and boundary rhs vectors. Defaults to MatrixValueType, but may differ (e.g. scalar matrix with Vec3 rhs for segregated vector solves).
The sparse matrix type used for the system matrix (default: CSRMatrix<MatrixValueType, localIdx>).
The sparse matrix type used for boundary and off-diagonal matrices (default: COOMatrix<MatrixValueType, localIdx>).
